description: An android version of the forge build site: a native Android client for the ForgeBuild dashboard — browse apps in apps/, view per-app releases/APK downloads, BUILD_STATE.json and PROMPT_HISTORY, and generate type-1 new-app contract prompts, all against the GitHub API of vjumbo264/forgebuild.

tasks.title: Choose slug (forge-android), create apps/forge-android/ as a copy of engine/, seed BUILD_STATE.json + PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-android.md, commit+push as push-access proof.
tasks.notes: Slug forge-android chosen by building AI (no collision in apps/: calcom, clipforge-android, forgehouse50, tapcounter, theme-showcase). engine/ copied verbatim as starting point. Slug recorded as FIRST field of this file and is permanent: folder apps/forge-android/, tags forge-android-vN, PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-android.md.

tasks.title: Set identity: namespace/applicationId com.forgebuild.forgeandroid in app/build.gradle.kts, app_name in res/values/strings.xml, move MainActivity to matching package.
tasks.notes: namespace/applicationId set to com.forgebuild.forgeandroid; app_name "ForgeBuild"; MainActivity moved to com/forgebuild/forgeandroid/ with package updated. Manifest references .MainActivity (resolves via namespace).

tasks.title: Adaptive icon via tools/make_adaptive_icon.py with created foreground artwork.
Confirm repo-level signing secrets exist (KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD) via GitHub API; do not regenerate.

Implement the app (one feature per commit): GitHub API data layer + INTERNET permission; apps list screen (cache-first); app detail screen (releases/APK/build state/prompt history); type-1 new-app prompt generator screen; navigation + M3 Expressive polish.
Validate build configuration, dispatch release.yml with app_path=apps/forge-android, verify forge-android-v1 release + APK asset via GitHub Releases API.
Set build_complete: true only after forge-android-v1 verified live.
